    Actor Patrick Muldoon, known for his roles on Days of Our Lives and Melrose Place, died on April 19, 2026, at age 57 from a sudden heart attack at his Beverly Hills home. His sister confirmed the cause, and he was found by his girlfriend, Miriam Rothbart, after a morning shower. 
    Key Details Regarding His Passing: 
    • Cause of Death: Heart attack.
    • Date: Sunday, April 19, 2026.
    • Location: Beverly Hills, California.
    • Age: 57.
    • Final Moments: According to reports, his partner, Miriam Rothbart, found him unconscious on the bathroom floor after he went to take a shower. 
    Muldoon was an actor, producer, and musician recognized for his roles in Days of Our Lives, Melrose Place, and Starship Troopers.

    Patrick Muldoon has passed away at 57 after a heart attack at his Beverly Hills home. Patrick carved out that classic TV heartthrob lane first popping up as Jeff on Saved by the Bell, then really breaking through as Austin Reed on Days of Our Lives, where he became a daytime staple. He carried that momentum into primetime drama on Melrose Place as the slick & scheming Richard Hart, before jumping to the big screen in cult sci-fi action like Starship Troopers as Zander Barcalow. Along the way, he showed up across TV movies, thrillers, and guest roles, building a steady career. R.I.P. Patrick.

    The 57 year old veteran actor Patrick Muldoon, who is best known for his role as Austin Reed on Days of Our Lives, has now taken his last breath. The reason for his death has been reported as heart attack. Born in California, he graduated from USC and started acting in college. Muldoon appeared in TV and films like Saved By the Bell, Super Troopers, and Melrose Place. Beyond acting, he produced several films and was passionate about music, leading the band The Sleeping Masses. He is survived by his partner, family, and relatives.💔🕊️
